items.title: Pathway steps and times are rarely reported
items.whyItMatters: Only 14 of 41 service reports described a reproducible pathway (claim c3), so the centre cannot copy a proven design.
items.opportunity: Chart each pathway's steps, owners and times in a fixed form.

items.title: Screening point determines the treatment window
items.whyItMatters: Screening at listing gave treatment before surgery to far more patients (claim c1).
items.opportunity: Chart where each pathway screens and how many days before surgery.

items.title: Referral thresholds vary
items.whyItMatters: Thresholds from 120 to 130 g/L and different ferritin cut-offs change who is referred (claim c2).
items.opportunity: Chart haemoglobin and ferritin triggers, including sex-specific thresholds.

items.title: Patients who do not speak English
items.whyItMatters: Patients who do not understand postponements are less likely to complete treatment.
items.opportunity: Chart whether pathways provide interpreters and translated information.

items.title: Postponement is an outcome and a harm
items.whyItMatters: Postponed patients report more pain and worry.
items.opportunity: Chart postponement rates and how pathways communicate them.

errorsFound: The need treats iron effectiveness as settled; the review should state that it is outside scope rather than settled by the retrieved records.
reevaluation: The gaps confirm a scoping review charting pathway steps, timing, triggers and communication.
summary: Five gaps; pathway reporting and screening point are high severity.
